user.title: Set up Portainer
user.description: Home Assistant will pull and run Portainer CE via the Docker engine. The Docker socket must be reachable from Home Assistant (for example by mounting /var/run/docker.sock).

data.stop_on_unload: Stop container when integration is removed

data_description.docker_host: Usually unix://var/run/docker.sock when the Docker socket is mounted into Home Assistant.
data_description.container_name: Name of the Docker container managed by this integration.
data_description.image: Portainer image tag to pull and run.
data_description.port: Host port published for Portainer HTTP (container port 9000).
data_description.ssl_port: Host port published for Portainer HTTPS (container port 9443).
data_description.volume_name: Docker volume used for Portainer persistent data.
data_description.ui_url: URL opened by the sidebar panel in your browser. Defaults to http://homeassistant.local:<port>.
data_description.stop_on_unload: When enabled, Portainer is stopped if you remove the integration.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Docker engine. Confirm the socket/URL is reachable from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_ui_url: Enter a valid http:// or https:// URL for the Portainer UI.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.
